dct_description_sm:
The Capital Budget Bridges and Intersections represent the road 
intersection improvements, bridge/culvert construction and grade 
separation improvement locations found throughout the city. These 
projects have all been identified in the capital budget and scheduled 
from the current year until 10 years later. The items from year 2-10 are
 part of the capital forecast and could be subject to change as priority
 setting and budget funding levels change.
